elements.text: Khana pet me gaya, saans lungs me gayi — par har cell tak delivery kaun karta hai?
Har cell ko oxygen aur glucose chahiye — 24x7
Ek pump — din me lagbhag 1 lakh dhadkan
Upar ke 2 = atria (blood RECEIVE karte hain). Neeche ke 2 = ventricles (PUMP karte hain).
Blood ek poore chakkar me heart se DO baar guzarta hai — isliye 'double circulation'
Lungs se O2 → heart → body → CO2 wapas → lungs. Aur beech me: pump.

beats.narration: Aaj hum body ke sabse mehnati organ se milne wale hain. Ye kabhi chhutti nahi leta — tumhare sote waqt bhi kaam karta hai. Chalo shuru karte hain.
Ek sawaal se shuru karte hain. Khana pet me pahunch gaya, oxygen lungs me aa gayi. Lekin tumhare pair ke angoothe ke cell ko dono chahiye. Wahan tak pahunchata kaun hai? Isi ka jawab hai circulation.
Iska engine hai heart. Ise koi jaadu ki cheez mat samjho — ye bas ek pump hai. Muscle ka bana hua, tumhari muthi jitna bada, aur din bhar me lagbhag ek lakh baar dhadakta hai.

beats.topic: Char chambers — RA, LA, RV, LV
beats.narration: Ab is pump ke andar dekho. Char kamre hain. Upar ke do atria — ye blood receive karte hain. Neeche ke do ventricles — ye blood ko dhakka dete hain. Right side aur left side ka kaam alag hai, aur wahi aage ki kahani hai.

Pehla chakkar chhota hai. Right ventricle CO2 se bhara blood lungs ko bhejta hai. Lungs me CO2 nikalti hai, oxygen chadhti hai, aur taaza blood left atrium me wapas aata hai. Ise kehte hain pulmonary circulation.

Doosra chakkar bada hai. Left ventricle — sabse taakatwar kamra — oxygen wala blood poori body me bhejta hai. Sir se lekar pair tak. Cells oxygen le lete hain, CO2 de dete hain, aur blood right atrium me wapas aa jaata hai.

Ab dhyan se dekho — ek poora chakkar lagane me blood heart se do baar guzra. Ek baar lungs jaane ke liye, ek baar body jaane ke liye. Isi liye ise double circulation kehte hain. Exam me ye seedha sawaal aata hai.
To kahani ek line me: lungs se oxygen, heart se dhakka, body me delivery, CO2 wapas, aur phir se. Agar kahin bhi atke ho, to haath uthao — main yahin hoon.
